title: Auto-prune operation volume at the gate; widen warning grace
description: Warning grace is keep(1000)+25 (doctor.ts:87-89); one sprint closeout generates more operations than the grace window, so agents pruned twice in one session. Default gate closeout to auto-prune to the keep target (machinery exists behind --auto-prune-operations) and raise the warning grace to ~250. Keep a hard cap that still blocks.
acceptanceCriteria: gate closeout prunes to OPERATION_LOG_RECOMMENDED_KEEP by default with an opt-out flag
Warning grace raised so a full sprint closeout cannot trip it; hard cap still blocks
closedReason: Acceptance criteria met; commit checkpoint recorded as dirty-path evidence because unrelated pre-existing staged and dirty changes prevent a scoped commit.
